takes.styleSnapshot: Warm slow Americana soul ballad, 68 BPM, gentle 6/8 sway, major key. Fingerpicked acoustic guitar and warm Hammond B3 organ, soft upright bass, light brushed drums, gentle pedal steel. Gritty gravelly male baritone, smoky and soulful but restful and unhurried, calm even in the valley. Soft gospel choir enters on the mercy bridge and stays low and warm to the end. Peaceful, tender, Sunday evening front porch.
